recognize_zh: 皮膚切片低倍：表皮下方真皮被梭形細胞增生取代，其間有不規則、裂隙狀的擴張血管腔，並散在淋巴球聚集；這是卡波西肉瘤（Kaposi sarcoma）的形態，屬於 PEL 病人同時具有的 KSHV 相關皮膚病灶，而非積液淋巴瘤本身。
features: Dermis expanded by a cellular proliferation of spindle cells between collagen bundles
Irregular, jagged, slit-like and dilated vascular spaces dissecting the dermis
Preexisting adnexal structure (hair follicle) surrounded by the proliferation (promontory-like pattern)
Overlying epidermis intact without significant atypia
describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows an intact epidermis overlying a dermis diffusely expanded by a proliferation of spindle cells arranged between collagen bundles. Numerous irregular, jagged and slit-like vascular spaces dissect the dermis, and there are scattered perivascular lymphoplasmacytic aggregates; a preexisting hair follicle is surrounded by the proliferation. No sheets of large lymphoma cells are seen. The findings are most consistent with Kaposi sarcoma (plaque stage) in a patient with KSHV/HHV8-associated primary effusion lymphoma; HHV8 LANA-1 immunostaining would confirm.

ddx.vs: Extracavitary PEL shows sheets of large CD45+/CD138+ immunoblastic cells rather than spindle cells with slit-like vessels.
Angiosarcoma has more atypical, multilayered endothelial cells lining anastomosing channels and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative.
Acroangiodermatitis shows lobular proliferation of thick-walled small vessels in the upper dermis without dissecting slit-like channels and is HHV8 negative.
Dermatofibroma shows storiform fibrohistiocytic cells with collagen trapping and lacks the jagged vascular channels and HHV8 positivity.
